Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.

[All Turns] When one of your level 5 or higher [Free] trait Digimon would be deleted in battle, by suspending this Tamer, you may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from that Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
[End of Your Turn] 1 of your [Free] trait Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon.
